description: Live desktop dictation with a themed overlay and local speech recognition.
notes: Run 'chitchat setup' once to download Python, the local speech engine and model, then 'chitchat start'.
Scoop installation does not enable startup at login. Settings, history and speech data are retained on uninstall.
Use one ChitChat installation at a time: Scoop and the Windows installer share user settings and speech data.
pre_uninstall: if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Could not stop ChitChat before updating or uninstalling.' }
foreach ($process in $owned) { if (-not $process.WaitForExit(10000)) { throw 'ChitChat did not stop; application files were preserved.' } }
